name: Azure Service Bus source connector for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now provides a generally available Azure Service Bus source connector. Customers can bring messages from Service Bus queues and topics into Microsoft Fabric for real-time processing without custom code.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to Azure Service Bus queues and topics.- Route Service Bus data to Fabric destinations for analysis and alerts.
